title: Two new LA roles: L'Oréal Luxe and Influential
intro: Two new LA roles today. The best fit is an Account Executive role for L'Oréal Luxe's YSL, Prada and Miu Miu Beauty brands, a brand-side beauty account role a lot like the CHANEL one you liked. There's also a manager-level Creator Management role at Influential, which is a stretch. Your earlier favorites are all still open.
notes: Today's search covered SMCP, CHANEL, L'Oréal, LVMH/Sephora/Dior/Louis Vuitton, Kering, Coty, Clarins, Pernod Ricard, Moët Hennessy, Rémy Cointreau, Accor, Westfield, Lacoste, L'Occitane/Sol de Janeiro, Universal Music, the Publicis and Havas agencies, and LinkedIn listings across the LA area.
SMCP Group: Greenhouse shows 42 US/Canada openings. LA-area openings are all boutique roles. No marketing, brand, or partnerships roles.
#57 Team One applications close around Nov 30, and #63 160over90 around Nov 27.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Self Assist (YSL / Prada / Miu Miu Beauty)
jobs.work_arrangement: In-store/field territory role; L'Oréal's hybrid policy allows up to 2 WFH days a week for eligible roles, with manager approval
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal Luxe division of L'Oréal (Paris HQ); brands are Yves Saint Laurent Beauté, Prada and Miu Miu Beauty.
jobs.why: Very close to the CHANEL Fragrance & Beauty AE you liked: a brand-side account role for French luxury beauty in LA. You'd own retail-partner relationships, grow sales across your stores, coach beauty advisors, and run in-store launch events. It builds directly on your AE skills.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3+ years in retail/service and 3+ years of beauty or retail management. Your account management carries over, but you haven't worked in beauty retail.

jobs.title: Manager, Creator Management
jobs.french_tie: Influential is a creator-marketing company owned by Publicis Groupe (Paris HQ).
jobs.why: A step up from the Creator Management Specialist role (#55) you asked a resume for. You'd run creator strategy and casting for Fortune 500 clients in beauty, auto and more, and talent can include musicians and chefs as well as influencers. It's still mostly influencer work, so it ranks below your client and partnerships favorites.
jobs.stretch_note: Big stretch: asks for 5+ years in influencer marketing and an established network of talent managers/agents.

jobs.title: Specialist, Client Management
jobs.french_tie: Influential is a creator-marketing company owned by Publicis Groupe (Paris HQ).
jobs.why: Still the most realistic fit: day-to-day brand-client management in beauty, CPG, and retail campaigns, with 3–5 years asked.
jobs.stretch_note: Mild stretch: wants digital/advertising or agency account experience.
jobs.status: You asked for a tailored resume (sent Nov 1).

jobs.french_tie: Team One is part of Publicis Groupe (Paris HQ).
jobs.travel: Up to 25% travel within the Western US, plus some nights and weekends for live events (no international travel mentioned).
jobs.why: The music, culinary, and culture experiential mix you liked, running Lexus Western-region programs and partnerships.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 5–7 years of event- or sports-marketing experience. Applications close around Nov 30.
jobs.status: You asked for a tailored resume (sent Nov 1).

jobs.title: Channel Market Manager (Off-Premise, Los Angeles)
jobs.work_arrangement: Field-based in the LA market (distributor ride-alongs and account calls); requires a valid driver's license and your own car
jobs.french_tie: Rémy Cointreau is a family-controlled French spirits group (Cointreau, Rémy Martin), headquartered in Paris.
jobs.travel: Not mentioned in the posting beyond field work in the LA market
jobs.why: A brand-side account role at a French spirits house: you'd own Rémy Cointreau's LA off-premise (retail) channel, build relationships with priority accounts and distributor teams, run business reviews, and coordinate sampling, displays, and brand programming with Marketing and Trade Marketing. Like the CHANEL and Coty roles, it's sales-leaning, but the account management and business-review skills from Gartner carry straight over.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 5+ years of relevant experience, including retail and/or three-tier (beverage alcohol) distribution. More sales than marketing.

jobs.travel: The posting asks for the ability to travel as needed (no destinations named).
jobs.why: Still the closest AE-level talent and partnerships match. Same agency as today's new Olympic role.
jobs.status: You asked for a tailored resume (sent Nov 1). Heads-up: 4 days a week in office.

jobs.title: Manager, Experiential Production
jobs.work_arrangement: In office at Westfield Century City 5 days a week (per the posting), plus some nights and weekends for events
jobs.french_tie: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield is headquartered in Paris and owns Westfield malls in the US.
jobs.travel: Not mentioned beyond supporting client meetings, tours, and travel "as needed" (no destinations named).
jobs.why: Experiential and brand-activation work at Westfield Century City: 50+ events a year (premieres, brand activations, pop-ups, seasonal celebrations). You'd be a key contact for brands and their agencies, manage client relationships before and after events, track the pipeline in Salesforce, and help with sales decks and upselling. That client-facing, revenue-minded side carries straight over from Gartner, and it's the culture-driven experiential mix you said you like.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 4–6 years of event production experience and a network of brand and agency contacts. Also 5 days a week in office, more than the 4 days you said was too much.

jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager, Influencer Marketing & Talent Relations (LA Studio)

The relationship-building and organization from your Gartner work carry over, but it is an influencer-focused job, which you said is lower on your list, so it's ranked below the client and partnerships roles.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–5 years in influencer or social marketing (beauty preferred), and names talent-agency backgrounds (CAA, WME, Gersh, UTA) as ideal.
